name: Closed Promenade
notes: Owner's description (2026-11-17): slow, quick, quick, slow, beginning in tango promenade after Two Walks and Progressive Link and ending in closed hold for Back Corté. The lead uses left, right, left, right; the follow mirrors with right, left, right, left. The second step crosses in front deliberately; the third uncrosses; the final slow closes the feet and turns each partner an eighth to face the other. No rise. Provisional geometry adjustment for the owner's vibes review (2026-11-18): the start stance already has the outside foot 0.6 m along the line of travel. Settle onto it with only 0.04 m more travel on the first slow, rather than extending to a 0.8 m stride with another 0.2 m. This caps the first stance at 0.64 m and reduces the worst default-body hip lowering from about 0.34 m to 0.136 m. The crossing foot travels 1.14 m from its original spot, landing the same 0.5 m past the standing foot as before. Both partners then uncross around the back of the standing foot: the follow previously took a straight route through her other footprint. The third-step offsets compensate for the shorter first slow, preserving all four original final foot positions (including the old rounded offsets), final facing, weights and rise; the extra decimal places preserve that endpoint, not a claim of dance-technique precision. The start pose, S Q Q S timing (three beats in 2/4), deliberate cross and closing turn are unchanged. Every authoring geometry check and the default-body leg-reach/16 cm hip-lowering tests now run without an exemption. Sizes and paths remain a modelling proposal for the owner to judge.
